content:
**Relay Tower EM-B1-27** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. [1] 

“This small hilltop military relay tower has a parked APC and possible access to a Vertibot drop”— Atlas of Appalachia

This is a standard radio relay tower with Machine Gun Turrets guarding the perimeter and its two entrances to the north and west. Inside is a blue system relay terminal which US Government Supply Requisition holotapes can be loaded into. There is a set of lockers in its southeastern corner and two First Aid on a shelf directly in front of the western entrance (one is locked - Picklock 0).

- AUTOMATED RECORD 0000002 - Holotape, found in a crate designated "Mysterious Box" directly west of the relay tower.
- Volunteers needed! - Note, found on the body of a Responder Volunteer near a house outside of the relay tower.
- Fusion Core - On top of the central control panel, along the wall closest to the repairable terminal.

- Request Government Air Drop - A US Government Supply Requisition holotape can be used in the relay tower terminal.
- Activity: Always Vigilant - Defend Rover while he conducts repairs to the relay tower.
- Hunter for Hire - Load the broadcast tape into the relay tower terminal.

Relay Tower EM-B1-27 appears in *Fallout 76*.

1. ↑ *Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide* p.289:*"**12. RELAY TOWER EM-B1-27****This small hilltop military relay tower has a parked APC and possible access to a Vertibot drop."*
(Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide/Atlas of Appalachia)
